## How it works

- [statement] At b0cac69ffcaf8d9b40e6303ac0051a4be065a730, isExpired returns false for an empty spec.deleteAfterDate. Otherwise it parses the string through timeutil.ParseISO8601 and returns true only when deleteAfter.Before(time.Now()) is true. A timestamp equal to the sampled clock is not expired. TestIsExpired covers absent, invalid, future and past dates, but does not assert the equality boundary. (high confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-kubernetes/b0cac69ffcaf8d9b40e6303ac0051a4be065a730/internal/controller/atlasdatabaseuser/databaseuser.go · keywords: Pinned AKO expired AtlasDatabaseUser reconciliation and unmanage lifecycle · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-kubernetes/b0cac69ffcaf8d9b40e6303ac0051a4be065a730/internal/controller/atlasdatabaseuser/databaseuser_test.go

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] In the pinned dbuLifeCycle, dbUserService.Get runs before the expiry check. An error other than dbuser.ErrorNotFound terminates with Internal and retry enabled, so expiry does not bypass Atlas lookup failures. A date parse error terminates with DatabaseUserInvalidSpec and retry disabled; the invalid-date fixture expects an empty result and a false DatabaseUserReady condition. (high confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-kubernetes/b0cac69ffcaf8d9b40e6303ac0051a4be065a730/internal/controller/atlasdatabaseuser/databaseuser.go · keywords: Pinned AKO expired AtlasDatabaseUser reconciliation and unmanage lifecycle · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-kubernetes/b0cac69ffcaf8d9b40e6303ac0051a4be065a730/internal/controller/atlasdatabaseuser/databaseuser_test.go
- [statement] When the pinned isExpired check returns true, the lifecycle first calls RemoveStaleSecretsByUserName with the resolved project ID and spec.username. On success it sets DatabaseUserReady from workflow.Terminate(DatabaseUserExpired, an expired user cannot be managed), then returns r.unmanage. The fixture confirms DatabaseUserReady=False with reason DatabaseUserExpired and that message. (high confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-kubernetes/b0cac69ffcaf8d9b40e6303ac0051a4be065a730/internal/controller/atlasdatabaseuser/databaseuser.go · keywords: Pinned AKO expired AtlasDatabaseUser reconciliation and unmanage lifecycle · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-kubernetes/b0cac69ffcaf8d9b40e6303ac0051a4be065a730/internal/controller/atlasdatabaseuser/databaseuser_test.go
- [statement] In the pinned expired/unmanage path, either cleanup failure terminates with DatabaseUserConnectionSecretsNotDeleted and retry enabled before finalizer removal. After successful cleanup, unmanage checks for customresource.FinalizerLabel and calls ManageFinalizer with UnsetFinalizer only when that finalizer exists. A removal failure terminates with AtlasFinalizerNotRemoved and retry enabled; success returns workflow.OK().ReconcileResult(). The helper does not delete the Kubernetes custom resource itself. (high confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-kubernetes/b0cac69ffcaf8d9b40e6303ac0051a4be065a730/internal/controller/atlasdatabaseuser/databaseuser.go · keywords: Pinned AKO expired AtlasDatabaseUser reconciliation and unmanage lifecycle · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-kubernetes/b0cac69ffcaf8d9b40e6303ac0051a4be065a730/internal/controller/atlasdatabaseuser/atlasdatabaseuser_controller.go
- [statement] The pinned user is expired fixture sets deleteAfterDate to 2021-05-30T13:45:30Z, username user1, databaseName admin and passwordVersion 888. Its user-service mock expects Get(context.Background(), admin, empty project ID, user1) returning nil,nil. The shared harness invokes dbuLifeCycle directly with an empty project.Project, asserts no Go error and ctrl.Result{}, and compares the expected DatabaseUserReady=False/DatabaseUserExpired condition while ignoring LastTransitionTime. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-kubernetes/b0cac69ffcaf8d9b40e6303ac0051a4be065a730/internal/controller/atlasdatabaseuser/databaseuser_test.go · keywords: Pinned AKO expired AtlasDatabaseUser reconciliation and unmanage lifecycle
- [statement] The pinned expired-user fixture supplies an input password Secret but no generated connection Secret, finalizer or deletionTimestamp. Its shared harness checks the reconciliation result, error and workflow-context conditions, without reading persisted secrets or finalizers afterward. Thus it asserts the expired condition and successful return through this setup, not actual connection-secret deletion, removal of an existing finalizer, persisted status from Reconcile, or successful live Atlas execution. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-kubernetes/b0cac69ffcaf8d9b40e6303ac0051a4be065a730/internal/controller/atlasdatabaseuser/databaseuser_test.go · keywords: Pinned AKO expired AtlasDatabaseUser reconciliation and unmanage lifecycle · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-kubernetes/b0cac69ffcaf8d9b40e6303ac0051a4be065a730/internal/controller/atlasdatabaseuser/atlasdatabaseuser_controller.go
- [statement] At the pinned commit, RemoveStaleSecretsByUserName calls secretservice.ListByUserName with the custom resource namespace, project ID and supplied username. A list error returns immediately. It attempts deletion of every returned Secret, continues after deletion failures, and returns the last deletion error; partial cleanup can therefore precede the caller's retry/finalizer-retention path. This describes the pinned helper, not a guarantee that all external credentials or sessions are revoked. (high confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-kubernetes/b0cac69ffcaf8d9b40e6303ac0051a4be065a730/internal/controller/atlasdatabaseuser/connectionsecrets.go · keywords: Pinned AKO expired AtlasDatabaseUser reconciliation and unmanage lifecycle · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-kubernetes/b0cac69ffcaf8d9b40e6303ac0051a4be065a730/internal/controller/atlasdatabaseuser/atlasdatabaseuser_controller.go

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] The successful pinned expired path calls RemoveStaleSecretsByUserName twice: once before setting DatabaseUserExpired, and again as the first operation in unmanage. Both calls use spec.username rather than atlasDatabaseUser.Status.UserName. This identifies the cleanup target without asserting the helper implementation or generic secret naming rules. (high confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-kubernetes/b0cac69ffcaf8d9b40e6303ac0051a4be065a730/internal/controller/atlasdatabaseuser/databaseuser.go · keywords: Pinned AKO expired AtlasDatabaseUser reconciliation and unmanage lifecycle · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-kubernetes/b0cac69ffcaf8d9b40e6303ac0051a4be065a730/internal/controller/atlasdatabaseuser/atlasdatabaseuser_controller.go

## Facts and statements

- [statement] The pinned expired branch returns before areDeploymentScopesValid and before dispatch on Atlas-user existence and metadata.deletionTimestamp. It therefore does not invoke the normal create, update or delete branch, even if the Atlas lookup returned an existing user; it does not itself issue dbUserService.Delete. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-kubernetes/b0cac69ffcaf8d9b40e6303ac0051a4be065a730/internal/controller/atlasdatabaseuser/databaseuser.go · keywords: Pinned AKO expired AtlasDatabaseUser reconciliation and unmanage lifecycle
